shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts | sed -n '1,180p' && sed -n '1,200p' package.json && sed -n '1,160p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "names and reports total usage|counts reported provider rounds|TotalUsage|validated by" specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git log -3 --oneline --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; elif [ -f scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs ]; then node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs; fi && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts && git commit -m "test(orchestrator): share usage fixtures" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
